source: Vielward.pdf (12 pages); approved user-specific Phase 9 appearance gate
caution: Observed complaints reflect source PDF screenshots; code evidence reflects source snapshot v1.2.6. This Phase 1 register does not claim any reported visual problem is fixed in current iPhone app.

issues.observation: Outdoor biome swap uses a Talk/portal action
issues.codeEvidence: Confirmed in v1.2.6: village ↔ wilds portal objects call changeZone
issues.acceptance: Walk from snow through thawline to green forest without a prompt, fade or teleport

issues.observation: Snowy brush inexplicably becomes lush Greenwood
issues.codeEvidence: Current scene assets are independently painted JPGs and geographically unrelated
issues.acceptance: Continuous road and gradual climate over believable travel distance

issues.observation: World feels like three isolated scenes rather than an expansive landscape
issues.codeEvidence: Three exterior-like zones include village, wilds and cave; forge art also exists
issues.acceptance: Whole proposed outdoor geography built and traversable before local slice refinement

issues.observation: Trying to walk left requires a large irrational detour
issues.codeEvidence: Local polygon mesh/axis sliding; screenshot illustrates mismatch
issues.acceptance: Traverse visibly clear adjoining ground directly using joystick

issues.observation: Walkable-looking roads terminate or have invisible barriers
issues.codeEvidence: Polygon collision separately traced over 900×584 images, not authored together
issues.acceptance: Every illustrated road leads to a real junction/destination or visible obstruction

issues.observation: Combat enemies need complete directional sprite sheets
issues.codeEvidence: Enemy atlas slots are selected static NPC cells with frame bobbing; no full enemy sheets
issues.acceptance: Each initial enemy has idle/walk/attack/stagger/death frames for relevant directions

issues.observation: Bandit looks like an ordinary civilian or duplicate hero
issues.codeEvidence: Current bandit uses actors_v07 slot 6; distinct asset quality not creator-approved
issues.acceptance: Bandit silhouette, clothing, equipment and animation read clearly as outlaw

issues.observation: Enemy variety should eventually exceed Skyrim without copying it
issues.codeEvidence: Current live hostile types: wolf, bandit and wraith only
issues.acceptance: Approved original bestiary with diverse types and distinct completed animation sets

issues.observation: Bright blue geometric pickup markers violate aesthetic
issues.codeEvidence: World objects use generic draw and icon primitives; source illustration is not an item atlas
issues.acceptance: Handmade pixel-art resource pickups with ground contact and no colored triangles

issues.observation: Objects seem randomly placed simply to look nice
issues.codeEvidence: Existing backgrounds are static compositions; objects are separately overlaid
issues.acceptance: Each prop placement justified by trail, ecology, ownership or gameplay role

issues.observation: Snowy northward path cannot be followed
issues.codeEvidence: Village ground/solids polygons fence off portions of pictured ledges
issues.acceptance: Reach the visually available northern trail without clipping solid walls

issues.observation: Cannot walk around the high monument
issues.codeEvidence: Current shrine forecourt is a narrow polygon surrounding solid plinth
issues.acceptance: Circumnavigate memorial along visible safe paths without walking on posts

issues.observation: Joren's visible workshop cannot be entered
issues.codeEvidence: Forge scene JPG exists but no accessible workshop door object/scene route
issues.acceptance: Real Enter interaction at visible workshop threshold and working interior/exit

issues.observation: Trail sign cannot be read
issues.codeEvidence: Board exists as abstract object at (845,600) with dialogue range; visual correspondence unverified
issues.acceptance: Stand near painted notice, use Read and receive meaningful readable text

issues.observation: Path dead-ends in bushes despite a lush-area transition
issues.codeEvidence: Village→wilds portal on snowy southwestern road, not continuous terrain
issues.acceptance: Road extends through connected geography with no bush-trigger teleport

issues.observation: Prominent river island has no logical access
issues.codeEvidence: No authored island route or transport interaction is implemented
issues.acceptance: Cross via visible bridge, ford or deliberate transport and land on mapped solid ground

issues.observation: Flower texture is abruptly cut off and outlined white
issues.codeEvidence: Bloom clusters are baked into JPG; masking/edge fidelity not validated
issues.acceptance: Foliage blends naturally with ground; no matte outline or abrupt rectangular cut

issues.observation: Character stands atop tree/canopy when following misleading route
issues.codeEvidence: No co-authored tree-footprint/foreground-depth layer; current nav lacks depth data
issues.acceptance: Foot point blocked at trunk; foreground canopy occludes character correctly

issues.observation: Visible Greenwood stone stairs cannot be climbed
issues.codeEvidence: Current world has flat 2D ground polygons and no elevation/h-level model
issues.acceptance: Climb actual stair treads to upper ground with correct shadow/elevation

issues.observation: Smuggler's Hollow rope bridge looks traversable but cannot be crossed
issues.codeEvidence: Cave bridge polygons historically repaired; iPhone screenshot still reports blockage
issues.acceptance: Walk entire bridge deck bank-to-bank with no rail/collision snag

issues.observation: Player visibly floats above chasm near lamp/post
issues.codeEvidence: Actor uses sprite/sole offsets and flat navigation; no per-foot elevation/depth
issues.acceptance: Boot soles and contact shadow align with actual bridge or stone floor

issues.observation: Chest-looking object seems fake or noninteractive
issues.codeEvidence: Single code chest is at cave (888,689); other chest-like shapes baked in painting
issues.acceptance: Real chest has reachable hitbox and reward; decorative chest not misleading

issues.observation: Mysterious oval ground marking can be walked on without explanation
issues.codeEvidence: No named oval interaction object in current nine-object setup
issues.acceptance: Marking is purposeful puzzle/lore/location or visually clearly ornamental

issues.observation: Spectacular violet magical shrine looks pointless
issues.codeEvidence: Code has Worldscar attunement dialogue + one XP reward, but no designed shrine exploration
issues.acceptance: Site has coherent approach, visual interaction, lore and meaningful one-time reward

issues.observation: Full outdoors must precede detailed mechanic slice
issues.codeEvidence: Old roadmap built only village/forest/cave prototype
issues.acceptance: Creator gets full outdoor layout to inspect before intensive slice polish

issues.observation: Beloved high-detail 3/4 pixel style must remain intact
issues.codeEvidence: Approved Wanderer atlas exists; scene JPGs have attractive but independent detail
issues.acceptance: Same material/pixel density/lighting and scaled actors across all region shots

issues.observation: Enter is appropriate at a real building, cave or ruin only
issues.codeEvidence: One wilds→cave entry exists, but snow→forest uses same mechanism
issues.acceptance: Exterior walking is seamless; enclosed entrances use believable thresholds

issues.observation: Individual monsters must stay consistent from front/back/side and in attacks
issues.codeEvidence: Wolf/bandit/wraith use atlas NPC cells, unlike protected 8-row player sheet
issues.acceptance: Creature remains recognizably same across all required frames

issues.observation: Trees, cliff foreground and bridge posts obscure real foot placement
issues.codeEvidence: Rendering sorts actor by y and uses alpha bounds; no authored roof/rail masks
issues.acceptance: Character correctly passes behind/in front of foreground geometry

issues.observation: Pickups should be visually integrated and intelligible
issues.codeEvidence: Objects currently use drawn symbols and simple glow over painted ground
issues.acceptance: Dedicated sprites for blueleaf, quest crate and magical pickups

issues.observation: Stairs, bridges and elevation need an integrated coordinate model
issues.codeEvidence: Current navigation projects image polygons into flat 1850×1200 scene
issues.acceptance: Each traverse uses shared elevation/nav/visual coauthored path data

issues.observation: Do not build every interior or cave before overworld review
issues.codeEvidence: Prototype has four scene images; no continuous outdoor streaming
issues.acceptance: Entire outdoor world walkable for review; interior depth deferred outside test slice

issues.observation: Prominent props and environmental landmarks must have believable purpose
issues.codeEvidence: Current object set has board, two herbs, one chest, one Worldscar plus portals
issues.acceptance: Visible usable objects behave consistently with appearance, and ornament is labeled

issues.observation: Creator requires appearance review after whole overworld is finished
issues.codeEvidence: Approved roadmap explicitly locks Phase 10 behind Phase 9 review
issues.acceptance: Stop after Phase 9 with full playable outdoor visual atlas; fix notes before approval
